title: 핵심역량강화를 위한 체계적 액션러닝 프로그램 개발-부산지역 관광컨벤션산업 중심으로-

abstracts.value: 본 연구의 목적은 부산지역의 관광컨벤션 산업 역량강화를 위한 액션러닝 프로그램을 개발하는데 있다. 구체적인 연구과제는 첫째, 관광컨벤션 산업의 서비스 역량과제를 분석하는 것이고, 둘째, 과제분석에 기초하여 이 분야의 핵심역량을 강화하기 위한 액션러닝 프로그램을 개발하는 것이다. 문헌분석에서는 액션러닝 관련 자료를 분석하여 본 프로그램의 교육방법의 틀을 잡는데 활용하였으며, 핵심역량에 대한 기존 연구를 분석하여 관광컨벤션 산업의 핵심역량강화를 위한 학습과제 분석의 기초를 마련하였다. 과제분석 결과로는, 첫째, 구체적인 학습내용과 프로그램 모듈 과제를 포함하는 시각적 도식을 제시하였으며, 학습과제의 계열을 결정하는데 도움을 줄 수 있는 학습위계를 도출하였다 프로그램의 개발 결과물로는 프로그램의 목적, 핵심학습과정, 프로그램의 청사진, 실제적 문제가 설계되었다. 그 후, 프로그램 초안은 해당분야의 학자, 실무자로 구성된 초점그룹 인터뷰와 워크숍을 통하여 수정작업을 거쳐 최종 프로그램을 개발하였다.

The purpose of this study is to develop an action learning program for enhancing core competence focused on tourism and convention industry in Busan. Specific research tasks are as follows: First, analyze the task of the service competence in tourism and convention industry. Second, develop action learning program for enhancing the core competence in the industry.
Researchers first analyzed the knowledge base related action learning as an instructional method in this program. Second, researchers also investigated the service competence in the tourism and convention industry in terms of expert interview and survey results gained in the previous research. As the task analysis results, there are the kinds of research outcomes. One is graphical expression of task analysis encompassing the detailed learning contents and program modules. The other is the learning hierarchy which guides the proper sequence of the learning tasks.
As the development outcome of the program, researchers designed the goal, core learning process, blue print, and authentic problems of the program. The core learning process of the program were as follows; authentic problem, problem identifying, problem clarifying, solution finding, solution prioritizing, action plan designing, implementing, and reflecting.
As for the research methodology, Researchers utilized focus group interview and workshop composed of several professors and practitioners suitable for the program development and obtained data and used them for redesign the program.
The blue print of this program contains the blue print of entire agenda and the blue print of learning module. Its longitudinal axis means the learning process while its horizontal axis means the structural frame of the learning, that is, the blue print of this thesis embodied learning support system for learning process. The entire process map of this research schematizes the whole action learning processes. This map consists of pre_session, learning module and post_session as followings; ① pre_session: prepare action learning ② module: action learning modules ③ post_session: reflect together.
